products.descriptionLong:
Hatec Compression Tube Fitting in carbon steel: 24 part numbers.

Specification

  • Type: Tube Fitting
  • Material: Carbon Steel
  • Part numbers: 24

Sizes and part numbers

The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every Hatec part number in this range with its connections. Ratings vary by size — check the row for the part you order.

Thread identification

Adapters only seal when both ends match the port they go into. JIC 37° and SAE 45° flares, NPT and BSPT tapers, and ORB, BSPP and metric parallel threads can look alike; quote the part number, or measure the thread and tell us the seat, and we will confirm the end types before supply.

How to order

Quote the Hatec part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
